这脉象倒是符合伤情啊，本来就是致命伤了，可她活着！

> Chapter 5 Do you have a headache (Page 1)
Lu Zhaoling's eyes were cold, and Mrs. Lu had already thrown herself in front of her, actually squeezing out two tears.
She grabbed the empty bowl on the table and threw it at Mrs. Lu.
"Ah!" Mrs. Lu was so frightened that her face turned pale. She subconsciously turned to the side to avoid it, but only heard a click.
"Oh my waist, my waist!" She screamed and called the maid to help her.
Lu Ming was furious and pointed at Lu Zhaoling, "You evil girl! You actually attacked your mother!"
"Isn't my mother dead? She is a woman who comes to the house to catch the autumn wind and climbs into bed. Does she deserve to be called mother?" Lu Zhaoling's face was expressionless.
Mrs. Lu froze and looked at Lu Zhaoling in disbelief. After she realized what she was doing, she immediately covered her face and started crying.
"Master, I'm not alive anymore! How could Zhao Ling slander me like this!"
Lu Ming supported her and glared at Lu Zhaoling, "Those who grew up in the countryside are vulgar and reckless! What have you done to me these days -"
Lu Ming suddenly woke up. The auxiliary doctor was still here. How could he let outsiders see his family's jokes?
He reluctantly calmed down and said apologetically to the auxiliary doctor, "It's really a joke to the auxiliary doctor. This evil girl Lu has been raised in the countryside. She just got her back today. Her words and deeds were rude and I bumped into you. Please forgive me."
The assistant doctor's beard trembled, "I came here to treat Miss Lu on the order of King Jin, not to see you making trouble."
"Master, my waist is sprained. Can the assistant doctor take a look at it first? It hurts." Mrs. Lu was twisted and couldn't stand straight, so she whispered to Lu Ming.
The auxiliary doctor walked to Lu Zhaoling and asked, "Can I see your injury?"
The assistant doctor's expression changed when he saw the redness and swelling on Lu Zhaoling's forehead, and he was even more shocked when he saw the wound on the back of her head.
No, it was such a serious injury. The blood stained her hair and back collar. The wound was so deep, but she was still alive?
The assistant doctor had seen similar victims before. The back of the head was hit so badly that he died immediately.
Now Lu Zhaoling can still sit here! Just a big swelling on her forehead is very serious.
He took Lu Zhaoling's pulse. It was so weak that it was almost impossible to feel it.
This pulse condition is consistent with the injury. It was originally a fatal injury, but she is alive!
"Strange thing, weird thing." The assistant doctor murmured, then changed his hand to check the pulse again, but still got the same result.
He stared at Lu Zhaoling with wide eyes. With this pulse condition, even if she didn't die, she would have been unconscious long ago. How could she still be sitting here sober?
The assistant doctor quickly called his attendant and asked him to open the medicine box, and he moved quickly.
She was so seriously injured, yet Mr. Lu and his family were still noisy and bothered to scold her. He had really learned a lot!
"Go get a basin of hot water!" The auxiliary doctor's tone became irritable to the Lu family, "Didn't you see that she bled so much?"
Lu Ming came over and took a look, and suddenly took a breath.
Lu Zhaoling had thick black hair like clouds, and he didn't notice that he was bleeding.
"How did she get hurt?" He turned to Mrs. Lu, "Didn't someone ask someone to pick her up? Where are those people?"
Mrs. Lu held her waist and choked, "Master, I don't know. I'm Du'an."
